title: Data and Insight Analyst
description:
Data and Insight Analyst needed Paying £320 per day ref 481321

Full time hours on a temporary basis

  • Key Responsibilities
    Data Analysis and Insight Development
    • Analyse complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, risks and opportunities.
    • Develop robust analytical products that provide meaningful insight into service performance and business outcomes.
    • Interpret and communicate analytical findings in a clear and accessible manner.
    • Produce business-focused recommendations based on data evidence and intelligence.
    • Support strategic and operational decision-making through the provision of high-quality analysis and insight.
    • Respond to ad hoc requests for data analysis and intelligence.
    Data Product Development
    • Design, develop and maintain dashboards, reports and other data products.
    • Translate stakeholder requirements into effective reporting and analytical solutions.
    • Support the development of self-service reporting tools and performance frameworks.
    • Ensure data products are accurate, user-friendly and aligned to business needs.
    • Drive continuous improvement in reporting, analytics and insight capabilities.
    • Contribute to the development of data standards and best practice.
    Business Intelligence and Performance Reporting
    • Develop and maintain management information and performance reporting systems.
    • Monitor key performance indicators and provide regular reporting on service outcomes.
    • Support the creation of performance frameworks and measurement methodologies.
    • Identify emerging trends and areas requiring improvement or intervention.
    • Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders at all levels.
